fx.rate_date: transaction date in the company timezone (invoice: issued_at; payment: timestamp)

ledger.credit_note: a cancelled invoice is reversed in full: Dr 4000 / Cr 1200 with the same invoice_id and no payment_id; a re-issued replacement is booked as a new invoice
ledger.currency: every ledger row is in base_currency
ledger.invoice: Dr 1200 / Cr 4000 at the invoice issue-date rate, only for invoices issued in the period
ledger.payment: Dr 1000 at the payment-date rate; Cr 1200 per invoice_ref at that invoice's issue-date rate (the ref that completes the invoice, i.e. adds up to its total_minor with the refs of earlier payments, credits the rest: convert(total_minor) - sum of the converted earlier refs); remainder (or all, if invoice_refs is null) Cr 2900 at the payment-date rate; difference to 7900; negative amount = refund: Dr 2900 at the payment-date rate of the receipt it returns (the same customer's latest earlier payment in that currency whose amount - sum of invoice_refs equals the refunded amount; the refund-date rate if there is none), Cr 1000 at the refund-date rate, difference to 7900

period.rule: a record belongs to the period iff its timestamp converted to the company timezone has a date in [start, end] (inclusive)

observation.task: You are auditing one company for one reporting period. Find misstatements in the ledger caused by: duplicate_invoice (the same invoice entered twice: same entity, currency and identical line items), payment_allocation (a payment's remittance says it pays an invoice but the ledger credits less to that invoice's receivable), fx_error (a foreign-currency amount converted with a rate of the wrong date), period_cutoff (an invoice issued outside the period booked in this period). The books may be clean. Split payments, partial payments, refunds, unidentified receipts and recurring equal amounts can be legitimate. Use the tools to read records (max 50 rows per page) and submit findings once; every action costs a step (max 100 including submit). Hard mode: the ledger is larger; line items keyed in by hand (some invoices, re-issues and duplicate copies) may be re-typed (other order, case and punctuation of the descriptions) with the same products, quantities and prices; an invoice cancelled by a full credit note and re-issued with the same line items is legitimate.

tools.returns: {rows, next_cursor, total}; invoice rows omit line_items
